pages.text: $(bold)Puppet Manipulation$(): with thread as the guide, with the puppet as the body. $(br2)Pressing the technique release key opens a selection screen showing $(bold)3D-rendered$() Iron Golems / Snow Golems to choose from; once chosen, the puppet is summoned in front of you and $(bold)your view shifts onto the puppet$() to control it. While controlling, your original body stays where it is and can be attacked; the puppet's health bar is shown at the bottom of the screen. $(br2)Cost: M = 1 + (Output + Affinity/10)/10. $(li)Iron Golem: one-time cost of $(bold)ceil(M×60)$() Cursed Energy$(li)Snow Golem: one-time cost of $(bold)ceil(M×35)$() Cursed Energy$(li)snowballs and knockback $(bold)cost nothing$(); recalling refunds $(bold)30%$()

$(bold)Iron Golem$(): $(li)$(bold)Left click$() melee attack, damage = round((4 + Output×4) × (1 + Affinity/100))$(li)$(bold)Right click$() knock enemies in front of you away (60° arc, 2.5 blocks, no direct damage)$(li)$(bold)Shift$() self-destruct: damage = (30 + Output×10) × (1 + Affinity/100), radius 5 blocks with linear falloff; does not destroy blocks$(br2)$(bold)Snow Golem$(): $(li)$(bold)Left click does nothing$()$(li)$(bold)Right click$() throws snowballs (one every 4 ticks), damage = round((2 + Output×2) × (1 + Affinity/100)), applying brief frost on hit$(li)$(bold)Shift$() self-destruct: damage = (12 + Output×6) × (1 + Affinity/100), radius 3 blocks; applies frost on hit$(br2)Controls are the same as Crow Manipulation: WASD to move, Space to jump, Shift to self-destruct, and your view determines the body's facing and shots.

$(bold)Details$(): $(li)press the technique key again to recall the puppet (refunds 30% Cursed Energy)$(li)puppet death / your own body's death → the view returns to you$(li)after a self-destruct, wait $(bold)max(200, 1200 - Output×40)$() ticks before summoning again$(li)puppet damage is $(bold)fully exempt$() against its master, Momo creatures hired by the master, and allied shikigami$(li)puppets drop no loot; leaving the control range pulls the puppet back to its master automatically
